## Pages (URL → file)

- `/(home)` app/(home)/page — Home page. ## Server actions

- app/account/security/actions ←1 — PASSWORD & EMAIL — changed by the person themselves. {SecurityState, changePassword, changeEmail}
- app/actions ←36 — SERVER ACTIONS — every mutation the dashboards can perform. {updateProduct, toggleProductHidden, toggleProductFeatured, batchUpdateProducts, deleteProduct, createProduct, BulkPhotoState, bulkImportPhotos, SaveState, updateStoreSettings, createPromotion, togglePromotion, deletePromotion, updateParcelDelivery, setOrderStatus, setStoreStatus, toggleStoreOwnSite, toggleStoreOfficial, TeamActionResult, addEmployee, updateEmployeeAccess, resetInviteLink, removeEmployee, updateCommissionSettings, updateMarketing, updateSections, saveBanner, deleteBanner, toggleBanner, moveBanner, savePromoTile, ResolvedParcel, submitOrderAction, getOrderAction, getUserOrdersAction, getWishlistProductsAction, getNewOrdersAction, markOrdersSeen, OrderParcel, getOrderParcelsAction, …}
- app/admin/accounts/actions ←2 — Password management for the marketplace administrator. {AccountActionResult, adminSetPassword, adminCreateResetLink, adminSetStoreOwner, adminRemoveStoreOwner}
- app/admin/categories/holding-actions ←1 — Filing products off the "Needs a category" shelf — one supplier grouping of one store at a time — and remembering the decision so that store's next import files {FileState, fileHeldProducts, HeldSuggestion, suggestHeldCategory}
- app/admin/categories/standard-actions ←2 — Linking Banaadir categories to the standard taxonomy (lib/taxonomy.ts): search it, get proposals (AI when configured, word matching otherwise), and save the lin {StandardOption, searchStandardAction, StandardProposal, ProposeResult, proposeStandard, linkStandard}
- app/admin/categories/tidy-actions ←1 — APPLYING A CATEGORY TIDY-UP The proposals come from lib/category-tidy.ts, an admin ticks the ones they agree with, and this carries them out. {TidyState, applyCategoryTidy}
- app/auth-actions ←7 — Sign-in / sign-out / sign-up server actions. {AuthActionState, SignInState, signIn, signUpCustomer, signUpSeller, switchStore, signOut}
- app/forgot-password/actions ←1 — Email a password-reset link — sent by Supabase Auth itself, so no mail provider has to be set up. {ForgotState, requestPasswordReset}
- app/invite/[token]/actions ←1 — Accepting an invitation. {AcceptState, acceptInvite}
- app/money-actions ←3 — Payouts and store ownership — the two places money and control change hands. {MoneyState, savePayoutDetails, recordPayout, removePayout, transferOwnership}
- app/reco-actions ←3 — Server actions for the recommendation engine. {getRecommendationsAction, ReviewSubmission, submitReviewAction, submitReviewFormAction}
- app/reco-sync-actions ←1 — Opt-in profile sync for signed-in shoppers (lib/reco/sync.ts). {getSyncedProfileAction, saveSyncedProfileAction, stopSyncAction}
- app/reset-password/actions ←1 — Redeeming a password reset link (see createResetLink in lib/accounts.ts). {ResetState, resetPassword}
- app/review-actions ←2 — Review moderation (lib/review-moderation.ts): shoppers report, the marketplace team decides. {ModerationResult, reportReviewAction, moderateReviewAction, removeReviewPhotoAction}
- app/search-actions ←1 — Suggestions under the header search box while the shopper types: the best few products (same ranking as the results page), plus departments and stores whose nam {SearchSuggestions, searchSuggestions}
- app/vendor/collections/actions ←1 — Store collections (lib/collections.ts): create, edit, reorder, delete. {CollectionState, saveCollection, deleteCollection, moveCollection}
- app/vendor/pos/actions ←4 — THE COUNTER — every write the till, the pantry and the recipes perform. {PosState, savePosSettings, addSupply, recordPurchase, adjustStock, deleteSupply, saveRecipe, deleteRecipe, applyPrice, makeBatch, SaleResult, ringUpSale, posDefaults}
- app/vendor/products/import/actions ←1 — SUPPLIER IMPORT — the three server actions the wizard calls. {InspectResponse, inspectUpload, CategoryScanResponse, scanFileCategories, PreviewProduct, PreviewPayload, PreviewResponse, previewImport, RunResult, RunResponse, runImport}
- app/vendor/products/suggest-actions ←1 — The product editor's "✨ Suggest" button — category and attribute suggestions for the product being typed in. {suggestProductDetails}
